title: Data from: A calcium-mobilizing biostimulant provides tipburn control comparable to vertical airflow fans in greenhouse hydroponic lettuce ‘Rex’
description: This dataset supports the peer-reviewed article “A calcium-mobilizing biostimulant provides tipburn control comparable to vertical airflow fans in greenhouse hydroponic lettuce ‘Rex’” (Frontiers in Plant Science 16:1701667; https://doi.org/10.3389/fpls.2025.1701667). Lettuce ‘Rex’ was grown in deep-water-culture hydroponics under summer greenhouse conditions in a split-plot randomized complete block design with two blocks. Treatments combined three concentrations of the calcium-mobilizing biostimulant CC US-2105 (0, 0.25, and 0.5 mL/L) with or without vertical airflow fans. Plant measurements were collected at 14, 21, and 28 days after transplanting. The deposit contains plant-level growth and tipburn measurements, inner-leaf tissue nutrient analysis at 28 days after transplanting, nutrient-solution pH/EC/temperature measurements, hourly greenhouse temperature/relative-humidity/vapor-pressure-deficit data, and greenhouse PPFD data. A README documents variable definitions, processing, quality-control checks, source-data limitations, and two explicitly missing tissue-analysis samples.
